issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 09 selects the column `kreis` but groups by `regierungsbezirk` (GROUP BY regierungsbezirk). The problem statement asks for averages per Landkreis (per `kreis`) and the name of the respective Landkreis. Grouping by `regierungsbezirk` while selecting `kreis` is a structural mismatch: in standard SQL you must either group by every non-aggregated selected column or aggregate it. This will either cause an SQL error in strict SQL modes or yield incorrect / nondeterministic results, and it does not implement the requested grouping "per Landkreis".
issues.suggested_fix: Group by the Landkreis column to match the requested aggregation per Landkreis. For example: SELECT kreis, AVG(einwohner_m), AVG(einwohner_w) FROM Gemeinde WHERE flaeche > 100 GROUP BY kreis; Ensure that every non-aggregated column in the SELECT appears in the GROUP BY so the query returns the averages per Landkreis as requested.
